summary: Conspiracy: Abyss Universe is a quick drafting card game where players build a pyramid of colored, numbered cards trying to complete key-matching or numeric sets before opponents. It plays fast and light, serving as a small-box spinoff of the Abyss universe rather than a full strategy game.
criticised: fairly light and forgettable for gamers seeking depth
luck of the draw can outweigh planning
overshadowed by the deeper Abyss base game

interaction.kind: open drafting with shared card pool
interaction.detail: Players draw from and leave cards in a shared communal pool, so choices affect what's available to opponents next, but each player builds their own private pyramid tableau. Interaction is indirect denial rather than direct confrontation.

subsystems: Lord placement into the reverse pyramid: determines your most influential Lord per color (Coat of Arms) and your largest same-color adjacent Coalition

Keys -> Locations: certain Lords grant silver/gold keys; two matching (or three any) keys let you claim a drafted Location card with a fixed or variable end-game IP value (and sometimes a special power)
Pearls -> Pearl Master: certain Lords grant Pearls; whoever holds the most Pearls holds the Pearl Master token, worth a flat bonus at game end
sources: Influence Points of your most influential Lord of each color
Influence Points of the Locations you control
3 points per Lord in your single largest same-color adjacent Coalition
5-point bonus for holding the Pearl Master token at game end
scoring.how_you_win: You draft Lord cards into a 15-slot reverse pyramid; when anyone completes their 15th slot the game ends (each other player gets one last turn), then everyone totals the IP of their best Lord per color, their controlled Locations, 3 points per Lord in their biggest same-color block, and a 5-point bonus if they hold the Pearl Master token — highest total wins.
